messages:
Alex: Heads-up — seeing ~30% spike in GPU pod evictions in ap-southeast1 since 08:10 UTC. Lots of small fractional-gpu pods Pending, and warm-pool nodes stuck in attach/detach loops. Also noticing egress bandwidth spikes across AZs. Anyone else?

Priya: yup saw it. attach timeouts then kubelet marks node NotReady -> pods get evicted. Quick paste of pending list: 
```
NAMESPACE   NAME                              READY   STATUS    RESTARTS   AGE   NODE
ml          tiny-job-abc                      0/1     Pending   0          2m    (none)
ml          tiny-job-def                      0/1     Pending   0          3m    (none)
research    batch-worker-12                   0/1     Pending   0          1m    (none)
```
Looks like many request `fractional-gpu: 0.125` and `nodeAffinity` prefers same rack.

Marta: ugh fragmentation + affinity = classic. If the scheduler is honoring rack-level affinity strictly and we have lots of fractional pods, they never pack. Are we still using the softAffinity binpack weight? Might be too low.

Dan: quick mitigations we can do now: increase warm-pool by +10% to absorb pending tiny pods and temporarily disable cross-AZ packing so pods stick to local AZ capacity. Also consider tainting some spare nodes `gpu:dedicated=true:NoSchedule` and using them as tiny-pod-pool.

InfraBot: [ALERT] 08:12 UTC — ap-southeast1: gpu-attach-errors increased from 3/m to 48/m; node-network-egress spiky (p95 820 Mbps). Auto-scaler paused due to attach failures.

Rachel: FYI cost note — if we blow up warm-pool by 10% for 24h that's ~+8% GPU hours for the region. Might need a quick spend approval if prolonged.

Priya: digging into kubelet logs now. ETA 12m. There's also a bump in `kubelet.volumes.attach` latency around the same time. Suspect network control-plane retries causing detach to hang. Adding a dashboard link: https://grafana/redwood/ap-southeast1/gpu-evicts

Alex: Proposed immediate plan:
1) Dan — bump warm-pool + cordon a few flaky nodes (hotfix) (action: Dan)
2) Priya — collect kubelet/attach logs and confirm if egress QoS is the root cause (action: Priya)
3) Marta — draft a scheduler policy tweak: increase binpack weight and relax rack affinity for fractional requests (canary later) (action: Marta)
4) Ops meeting 09:00 UTC to decide on enabled schedule changes and cost tradeoffs (owner: Alex)

Marta: I'll prototype scheduler policy change in staging now. If we shift binpack threshold from 0.7 -> 0.85 we should reduce fragmentation for small jobs. Will also test relaxing topologyAffinity for pods with `fractional-gpu` label.

Dan: doing the warm-pool resize now. Also temp-set `topologySpread` tolerance lower to avoid cross-az scheduling. Will report back in ~5m.

Priya: gathered attach log snippet: 
```
May 02 08:11:23 kubelet[...]: failed to attach volume: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
May 02 08:11:27 kubelet[...]: NodeNotReady: network interface flapped during detach
```
Matches InfraBot spikes.

Rachel: tagging finance and sales for visibility on potential spend hit. If this goes >4h we'll need escalation.

Alex: OK thanks — short-term we're doing warm-pool + AZ packing toggle. Medium-term: scheduler policy + gang/co-scheduling exploration for small fractional jobs. Meeting 09:00 UTC — calendar invite sent.

Marta: ack :thumbsup:

Dan: warm-pool +10% done, cordoned 2 nodes for probe. Evictions rate down ~12% in last 60s.

Priya: still seeing a handful of attach failures but pod pending queue length cut in half. continuing logs.

Alex: nice. follow-ups: Marta will open a PR for scheduler change; Priya to paste logs in incident channel; Dan to revert AZ toggle after canary. We'll reconvene in the 09:00 UTC call.

Rachel: noted for cost tracking — I'll add a temp tag to warmpool nodes for chargeback.

InfraBot: [INFO] 08:15 UTC — mitigation actions observed: warm-pool resized, 2 nodes cordoned. Eviction rate decreasing.

Alex: closing the loop here for now. Thanks all.
